title: Add changeset for patch release
body:
Adds a changeset to trigger a patch bump (`3.0.0` → `3.0.1`) for the fixed version group.

- Changeset file: `.changeset/patch-release.md` targeting `@objectstack/spec` with `patch` bump
- All packages in the `fixed` group (spec, cli, core, runtime, objectql, etc.) will be bumped together when `changeset version` is run
